values.opening: Good people. Serious skills. MMA in the heart of Galway, built on trust, live training and the enjoyment of getting better.
values.hero_photo_alt: Strange Wolves MMA coaching and competing cage-side
values.course_photo_alt: MMA intro course starts September 28th, Mondays and Thursdays at 8 PM, beginners welcome, Creaven House, Claddagh Quay
values.experienced_intro: Already trained in jiu-jitsu, MMA, kickboxing, Muay Thai or wrestling? You’re welcome to join us. Bring your experience and we’ll help you connect it to the rest of MMA.
values.experienced_rounds: Expect live training games, positional rounds and technical sparring with specific goals. Tell the coach where you’re coming from and train with care for the person in front of you.
values.coach_1_bio: An outside-the-box thinker who built his own way of developing complete MMA skills. Vinny created the Bronze, Silver and Gold Wolves system: no belts, just a standard earned across the whole sport.
values.coach_2_bio: Marcus combines hands-on coaching with running the club: organising training, making the day-to-day decisions and keeping the room moving. A coach committed to the progress of the people training in it.
values.coach_3_bio: Practical, crafty and full of useful details that stay with you. John brings an old-school edge, a punk-rock spirit and a wicked, unfiltered sense of humour. Semi-retired, but very much part of the club’s character.
values.ethos_intro: Wolves in sheep’s clothing. A nonprofit club with serious ability, where getting better matters more than looking tough. Compete if you want to. You don’t have to.
values.ethos_training: No pad-work routines or push-up circuits. We build skills through live training games, positional sparring and technical rounds with a specific task to solve. You learn timing, decisions and what works against a partner who is responding.
values.ethos_trust: That only works with trust. Challenge each other, control the intensity and help your training partners improve. Skills, confidence, enjoyment—and a reason to keep coming back.
values.ethos_photo_alt: Three Strange Wolves members together after training
values.grading_intro: Created by founder Vinny Connolly, the Bronze, Silver and Gold Wolves system recognises progress across the complete sport—not belts or time served. The coaching team agrees when a level has been earned. There are no paid grading days, and no pressure to compete.
values.bronze_description: A dependable base across striking, wrestling and grappling, with the ranges beginning to connect.
values.silver_description: Technical depth, composure and a complete MMA skill set suited to the amateur circuit.
values.gold_description: A complete, tested game capable of operating at professional level.
values.podcast_intro: MMA, UFC, bare-knuckle boxing, listener questions, Steven Seagal films and whatever else gets dragged into the cage.
